# KaleidoSwap

> Trustless atomic swap protocol built natively on Bitcoin. Built for humans and AI agents alike.

KaleidoSwap is an infrastructure layer enabling trustless atomic swaps across multiple Bitcoin Layer 2 protocols, including Lightning Network, RGB, Arkade, Liquid, and Spark. The RFQ (Request for Quote) model lets market makers compete on spread, providing best-execution pricing for users and integrators. Non-custodial, open source, and private by design.

---

## Products

- [KaleidoSDK](https://docs.kaleidoswap.com/sdk/introduction.md): Multi-language SDK (Rust core, TypeScript and Python bindings). MCP-compatible. For wallet builders, multi-L2 wallet builders, neobanks, and AI agent developers.
- [Kaleido CLI](https://docs.kaleidoswap.com/cli/introduction.md): Command-line tool for managing local RGB Lightning nodes and executing swaps directly from the terminal. Ships with KaleidoSDK.
- [Desktop App](https://docs.kaleidoswap.com/desktop-app/getting-started/introduction.md): Tauri-based (Rust + web frontend). Full self-hosted RGB Lightning node. Non-custodial. Available on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- [Browser Extension](https://docs.kaleidoswap.com/extensions/kaleidoswap-extension/introduction.md): Multi-network, multi-protocol Bitcoin wallet extension. Accounts for Lightning, Liquid, Spark, Arkade, Nostr, and an optional RGB Lightning Node. Closed beta.
- Rate (Mobile): Self-sovereign RGB Lightning wallet for iOS and Android with an on-device AI assistant. In beta, not yet publicly released.
- KaleidoAgent: Autonomous AI agent built on KaleidoSDK. Manages Lightning wallets, executes swaps, handles DCA and rebalancing autonomously.
- KaleidoMind: On-device AI agent embedded in the Desktop App and mobile wallet — chat-driven swaps, balances, and wallet operations.
- KaleidoMaker: Production-grade market-maker infrastructure. RFQ engine, turnkey LP stack, with Prometheus/Grafana/Loki observability. Operated by KaleidoSwap; not yet publicly available.

---

## Supported Protocols

Live:

- Bitcoin (onchain)
- Lightning Network
- RGB Protocol on Lightning (RGB20 assets)
- Spark (statechains)
- Arkade / Ark (virtual UTXOs)
- Liquid Network (L-BTC and Liquid assets)

In development:

- Taproot Assets
- Wavelength
- Cashu
